observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 console standing vertically on a wooden desk.
The console has the PlayStation logo on the top left corner.
A black PlayStation controller is placed on top of the console.
The background includes game posters, including 'The First Descendant' and 'PC Engine'.
A fan is visible to the left, and various cables and items are on the desk.
The console appears clean and undamaged from this angle.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean, undamaged console with no visible scratches or wear. The controller is also intact.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage not visible in photo.
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have battery issues.
risks.proof: Video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to inputs.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number.
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number sticker on the back of the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced with risk of legal issues

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the serial number sticker.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and working with the console.
Photo of the console's ports and any damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
